content.title: The Fifty-Third Chapter of Isaiah according to the Jewish Interpreters, volume 2: Translations
content.author: S. R. Driver and Adolf Neubauer, translators, with an introduction by E. B. Pusey (Oxford and London: James Parker, 1877)
content.role: Primary record · not a teaching authority
content.note: English translations of Jewish readings of Isaiah 52:13–53:12 from the Talmud and Targum to the nineteenth century, in roughly chronological order: the Targum of Jonathan (pp. 5–6), Rashi (pp. 37–40), Ibn Ezra, Kimchi, Abarbanel and others. For the Jewish readings in their own words. Pusey's introduction argues a Christian case and is cited as his. Public domain: may be quoted, with the translators named and an exact locator.
content.read: Downloaded 2026-11-27 to sources/archive-org/driver-neubauer-isaiah-53-jewish-interpreters-v2-1877.txt (Internet Archive fiftythirdchapte02neub; checksum in Website/SOURCES.md, 'Apologetics fields: Jesus & resurrection'). 2026-11-27 (plan APOLOGETICS-FIELDS step 7): the preface's list of interpreters, the Targum on 52:13–53:6 (pp. 5–6), Rashi on 52:13–53:9 (pp. 37–39) and the fragment Martini attributes to Rashi (pp. 39–40), and Pusey's introduction pp. xliv–xlv read for messianic-prophecy. Described, not quoted.
